deadline.value: Portal applications are due December 1, 2026, the year before matriculation; later applications are reviewed only if space remains.
deadline.quote: Fall Dec 1 of year before matriculation

gre_general.value: The catalog does not state a GRE rule for these PhDs.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not say how many students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants typically hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent at enrollment, with an undergraduate GPA of 3.5.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree or its equivalent at the time of enrollment, with an undergraduate GPA of 3.5

toefl_min.value: The portal asks for a TOEFL score of 100 (iBT) for applicants whose second language is English, above the university's 80.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL scores of 600 (pBT), 250 (cBT) or 100 (iBT) for individuals for whom English is a second language

notes: Applications go through the Biomedical Sciences Doctoral Portal (School of Medicine). The five PhDs share the same Dec 1 deadline and TOEFL rule in their catalog pages. The Neuroscience PhD uses the same portal and is saved as the neuro record. Not saved: Oral Health Research (School of Dentistry), Pharmaceutical Sciences (School of Pharmacy), Clinical and Translational Sciences, and Epidemiology PhDs.
name: Biomedical Sciences Doctoral Portal (Biochemistry, Human Genetics, Microbiology and Immunology, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Physiology and Biophysics PhDs)
